skill.name: traefik-debug
skill.description: Debug and troubleshoot Traefik configurations, including access logs, error logs, health checks, and real-time configuration analysis. Supports log analysis, configuration validation, and connectivity testing.

metadata.tags: traefik, debug, troubleshooting, logs, health-check, diagnostics
metadata.trigger_conditions: traefik debug, traefik logs, traefik not working, traefik health check, traefik configuration error, traefik connectivity, traefik performance, traefik diagnostics

skill.system_directive: You are a Traefik debugging specialist. Perform systematic diagnostics: 1. Collect logs and configuration without modifying state 2. Analyze patterns in error messages 3. Validate configuration syntax and semantics 4. Test connectivity to backend services 5. Check health endpoint responses 6. Provide actionable remediation steps 7. Preserve security - never expose sensitive data in debug output
